The '''291st Legion''' was a [[Legion/Legends|legion]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]]. It was notable as being one of the few Stormtrooper units to accept [[Gender/Legends|female]] recruits. [[Isila Drutch]] served in the 291st in the [[Dalisor system/Legends|Dalisor system]] after graduating from the [[Carida Academy/Legends|Academy of Carida]]. Two other female personnel, [[TD-1123]] and [[TD-5144]], also served in this unit.

The legion saw action in and around the [[Yushan sector/Legends|Yushan sector]]: it was involved in a battle with insurgent aboriginals on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Jiroch-Reslia]], where [[TD-1123]] was [[Death/Legends|killed]].
